name: Farah
source:
Horoscope: Taurus

Skills: Determined, empathetic, diligent

History: A S.Human veteran born and raised in Love Shore, Farah's biggest muscle is her heart. She's coping with life after prison and trying to re-adapt to civilian life when she's drawn into a war between the gods that could threaten the foundations of the city.

Personality: The strong and silent type, Farah is quick to support her friends.

Flaws: Unobservant, overly trusting

Trivia: Farah's kitchen is pristine because she's the type of person who would burn ramen noodles.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1410330/Love_Shore/]Steam[/url]]
